Tulachermet PAO Reports Stable Trade Volumes in Latest Quarterly Update

Tulachermet PAO, a leading Russian metals producer, released its routine trade figures for the second quarter, indicating stable export and domestic sales amid consistent industry demand. According to company data published on Friday, shipments of pig iron, Tulachermet PAO’s primary product, totaled 600,000 metric tons for the quarter ending June 30. This figure matches the volume reported for the same period last year, reflecting steady market conditions.

Export volumes accounted for approximately 72% of total sales, with key destinations including markets in Europe, Southeast Asia, and North Africa. Domestic demand remained robust, with the construction and machinery manufacturing sectors showing continued resilience, according to the company’s statement. “We are pleased to see sustained demand across our key markets, both in Russia and abroad,” said Elena Morozova, Tulachermet PAO’s Director of Commercial Operations. “Our ongoing focus on operational efficiency has helped us to maintain consistent supply levels.”

Industry analysts noted that the figures align with broader trends in the Russian metals sector. Ivan Petrov, an analyst with the Moscow Metal Market Association, commented, “Stable output and export volumes from Tulachermet PAO are a positive sign for the industry, indicating no significant disruptions in supply chains or end-user demand this quarter.”

The Russian Association of Steel Producers reported that overall pig iron exports from the country remain near last year’s levels, despite global market uncertainties. “Russian producers have adapted well to evolving trade patterns,” the association said in a statement.

Looking ahead, Tulachermet PAO reiterated its intention to focus on efficiency and reliability in operations. The company reported no significant changes in staffing, supply chain arrangements, or logistics partners, including its ongoing collaboration with TransMetall Logistics, a major transportation provider.

Shares of Tulachermet PAO ended the day unchanged on the Moscow Exchange following the release.
